features.description: Bookmarks can be added, listed, jumped to and removed, and survive a reload
Selected text can be highlighted; highlights stay aligned at any scale and survive a reload
Notes can be attached to a highlight or a page, listed in a panel, and survive a reload
The app installs as a PWA and its shell opens offline
A book and its annotations added on one device appear on another device
Each book reopens at the last reading position

The library shows covers and reading progress, with sort and filter
A book's highlights and notes export to a Markdown file
Full-text search in the open book lists matches and jumps to each one
